```{r}
#| label: matrix-rendering-setup
#| include: false
#| cache: false
# Keep formatting helpers local: rendering never changes analysis objects.
local({
  format_numbers <- function(x, digits, p_value = FALSE, integer_if_whole = FALSE) {
    out <- formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)
    out[is.na(x)] <- "NA"
    whole <- integer_if_whole & is.finite(x) & x == trunc(x)
    out[whole] <- formatC(x[whole], format = "f", digits = 0)
    if (p_value) {
      small <- is.finite(x) & x >= 0 & x < 0.001
      out[small] <- "< .001"
    } else {
      # Preserve nonzero likelihoods and other values that would round to zero.
      small <- is.finite(x) & x != 0 & round(x, digits) == 0
      out[small] <- formatC(x[small], format = "e", digits = max(0, digits - 1))
    }
    out
  }

  render_table <- function(x, options, caption = NULL, row_names = TRUE,
                           p_columns = character(),
                           int_columns = c("Df", "Df diff", "df", "df.scaled"),
                           digits = NULL) {
    if (is.null(digits)) {
      digits <- options$matrix.digits
      if (is.null(digits)) digits <- 3L
    }
    # Classes such as psych's "loadings" have data-frame methods that retain
    # a matrix column. Use a plain matrix so kable receives scalar columns.
    if (is.matrix(x)) x <- unclass(x)
    x <- as.data.frame(x, optional = TRUE)
    alignment <- vapply(x, function(col) if (is.numeric(col)) "r" else "l", "")
    for (name in names(x)) {
      if (is.numeric(x[[name]])) {
        x[[name]] <- format_numbers(x[[name]], digits,
                                    p_value = name %in% p_columns,
                                    integer_if_whole = name %in% int_columns)
      }
    }
    html <- knitr::is_html_output()
    if (html && !is.null(caption)) caption <- htmltools::htmlEscape(caption)
    table <- knitr::kable(
      x, format = if (html) "html" else "pipe",
      row.names = row_names, align = alignment, caption = caption,
      escape = TRUE,
      table.attr = if (html) 'class="matrix-table"' else ""
    )
    if (html) {
      paste0("\n\n```{=html}\n", table, "\n```\n\n")
    } else {
      paste0("\n\n", table, "\n\n")
    }
  }

  # fitMeasures() loses its lavaan class when subsetted. Recognize only a
  # conservative set of metric names, rather than formatting arbitrary vectors.
  fit_names <- c("chisq", "df", "pvalue", "chisq.scaled", "df.scaled",
                 "pvalue.scaled", "chisq.scaling.factor",
                 "baseline.chisq", "baseline.df", "baseline.pvalue",
                 "rmsea", "rmsea.ci.lower", "rmsea.ci.upper", "rmsea.pvalue",
                 "rmsea.scaled", "rmsea.robust",
                 "rmsea.ci.lower.robust", "rmsea.ci.upper.robust",
                 "srmr", "srmr_within", "srmr_between",
                 "cfi", "cfi.scaled", "cfi.robust",
                 "tli", "tli.scaled", "tli.robust",
                 "aic", "bic", "bic2", "npar", "logl", "unrestricted.logl")
  fit_int_names <- c("df", "df.scaled", "baseline.df", "npar")
  fit_labels <- c(chisq = "Chi-square", df = "df", pvalue = "p-value",
                  chisq.scaled = "Scaled Chi-square", df.scaled = "Scaled df",
                  pvalue.scaled = "Scaled p-value",
                  chisq.scaling.factor = "Scaling factor",
                  baseline.chisq = "Baseline Chi-square",
                  baseline.df = "Baseline df", baseline.pvalue = "Baseline p-value",
                  rmsea = "RMSEA", rmsea.scaled = "Scaled RMSEA",
                  rmsea.robust = "Robust RMSEA",
                  srmr = "SRMR", srmr_within = "SRMR (within)",
                  srmr_between = "SRMR (between)",
                  cfi = "CFI", cfi.scaled = "Scaled CFI", cfi.robust = "Robust CFI",
                  tli = "TLI", tli.scaled = "Scaled TLI", tli.robust = "Robust TLI",
                  aic = "AIC", bic = "BIC", bic2 = "Adjusted BIC", npar = "Parameters")

  matrix_tree <- function(x) {
    is.matrix(x) || (is.list(x) && length(x) > 0L &&
      !is.null(names(x)) && all(vapply(x, matrix_tree, logical(1))))
  }
  is_param_index_tree <- function(x) {
    collect_vals <- function(obj) {
      if (is.matrix(obj)) return(as.numeric(obj))
      unlist(lapply(obj, collect_vals), use.names = FALSE)
    }
    vals <- collect_vals(x)
    if (length(vals) == 0L || any(!is.finite(vals))) return(FALSE)
    if (any(vals < 0 | vals != floor(vals))) return(FALSE)
    pos <- sort(unique(as.integer(vals[vals > 0])))
    length(pos) >= 1L && identical(pos, seq_len(max(pos)))
  }
  is_lavaan_moment_leaf <- function(x) {
    (is.matrix(x) && inherits(x, c("lavaan.matrix", "lavaan.matrix.symmetric"))) ||
      inherits(x, "lavaan.vector")
  }
  is_lavaan_moment_tree <- function(x) {
    if (!is.list(x) || is.object(x) || length(x) == 0L || is.null(names(x))) {
      return(FALSE)
    }
    elts <- x[names(x) != "type"]
    if (length(elts) == 0L) return(FALSE)
    has_type_ok <- !("type" %in% names(x)) ||
      (is.character(x$type) && length(x$type) == 1L)
    has_type_ok && all(vapply(elts, function(el) {
      is_lavaan_moment_leaf(el) || is_lavaan_moment_tree(el)
    }, logical(1)))
  }
  is_lavaan_table <- function(x) {
    is.data.frame(x) && nrow(x) > 0L && (
      inherits(x, "lavaan.data.frame") ||
      all(c("lhs", "op", "rhs") %in% names(x))
    )
  }
  render_matrices <- function(x, options, path = character(), digits = NULL,
                              type_label = NULL) {
    if (is.matrix(x)) {
      if (nrow(x) == 0L || ncol(x) == 0L) return("")
      if (is.null(rownames(x))) rownames(x) <- seq_len(nrow(x))
      if (is.null(colnames(x))) colnames(x) <- seq_len(ncol(x))
      cap <- if (length(path)) paste(path, collapse = " / ") else NULL
      if (!is.null(cap) && !is.null(type_label)) {
        cap <- paste0(cap, " (", type_label, ")")
      }
      return(render_table(x, options, caption = cap, digits = digits))
    }
    if (inherits(x, "lavaan.vector")) {
      if (length(x) == 0L) return("")
      vec_mat <- t(as.matrix(unclass(x)))
      if (is.null(colnames(vec_mat))) colnames(vec_mat) <- seq_len(ncol(vec_mat))
      cap <- if (length(path)) paste(path, collapse = " / ") else NULL
      if (!is.null(cap) && !is.null(type_label)) {
        cap <- paste0(cap, " (", type_label, ")")
      }
      return(render_table(vec_mat, options, caption = cap, row_names = FALSE,
                          digits = digits))
    }
    if ("type" %in% names(x) && is.character(x$type) && length(x$type) == 1L) {
      type_label <- x$type
      x <- x[names(x) != "type"]
    }
    parts <- vapply(names(x), function(name) {
      render_matrices(x[[name]], options, c(path, name), digits = digits,
                      type_label = type_label)
    }, "")
    paste(parts[nzchar(parts)], collapse = "\n")
  }

  knitr::opts_chunk$set(render = function(x, options, ...) {
    if (!isTRUE(options$inline)) {
      if (is.matrix(x) && length(x) > 0L) {
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_matrices(x, options)))
      }
      if (inherits(x, "lavaan.list") && matrix_tree(x)) {
        digits <- if (is_param_index_tree(x)) 0L else NULL
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_matrices(x, options, digits = digits)))
      }
      if (is_lavaan_moment_tree(x)) {
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_matrices(x, options)))
      }
      if (is_lavaan_table(x)) {
        int_cols <- intersect(
          names(x),
          c("id", "user", "block", "group", "level", "free", "exo",
            "df", "df.scaled", "Df", "Df diff")
        )
        p_cols <- intersect(names(x), c("pvalue", "p.value"))
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_table(
          x, options, row_names = FALSE, p_columns = p_cols,
          int_columns = int_cols
        )))
      }
      if (inherits(x, "anova") && is.data.frame(x)) {
        # Retain test names, model formulas, and robust-test notes from R.
        heading <- paste(attr(x, "heading"), collapse = "\n")
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_table(
          x, options, caption = heading,
          p_columns = names(x)[grepl("Pr\\(|pvalue|p.value", names(x))]
        )))
      }
      if (is.numeric(x) && is.null(dim(x)) && length(x) > 1L &&
          !is.null(names(x)) &&
          all(names(x) %in% fit_names)) {
        labels <- names(x)
        known <- labels %in% names(fit_labels)
        labels[known] <- unname(fit_labels[labels[known]])
        digits <- if (is.null(options$matrix.digits)) 3L else options$matrix.digits
        values <- format_numbers(unname(x), digits,
                                 integer_if_whole = names(x) %in% fit_int_names)
        p <- grepl("pvalue", names(x), fixed = TRUE)
        values[p] <- format_numbers(unname(x[p]), digits, p_value = TRUE)
        return(knitr::asis_output(render_table(
          data.frame(Measure = labels, Value = values), options, row_names = FALSE
        )))
      }
    }
    knitr::knit_print(x, options = options, ...)
  })
})
```
